title: Auto-order more milk before the morning rush
narrative: A SHIFT_SCHEDULED event arrives and the agent starts the shift. Looking at inventory, it sees milk is running low for the 9 AM rush and decides to auto-order more under the auto_order policy (medium-risk, no human approval). The receipt below is the tamper-evident proof of that decision.

steps.description: Ingest a SHIFT_SCHEDULED event so the cafe runtime knows there's a shift starting at 9 AM. The shift lands in the NEW state.
Start the shift. START_SHIFT runs from NEW and emits a SHIFT_STARTED event that moves the shift into OPEN, where inventory actions are allowed.
Run the AUTO_ORDER_INVENTORY action on the now-OPEN shift. The agent's decision is signed and the receipt is anchored on Base Sepolia.
